why.title: When a single-brand plan stops being enough.
why.description: Enterprise is for teams that need one agent-commerce layer across brands, regions, and security requirements — not another self-serve seat.
paragraphs: Dominate runs the full optimization loop for one brand. Enterprise adds the control plane: multi-brand rollups, SSO, API access, managed UCP signing, and a named CSM who owns the relationship.
The decision usually shows up when catalog size, brand count, or procurement requirements outgrow a flat monthly plan.

faqSection.title: Enterprise FAQ
faqSection.description: Common questions about Enterprise plans, security, and onboarding.

items.question: When should I choose Enterprise over Dominate?
items.answer: Choose Enterprise when you run hundreds of SKUs across multiple brands or regions, need SSO or a DPA, want UCP signing managed for you, or need a dedicated CSM and custom API access. Dominate covers the full optimization loop for a single brand up to 1000 products.

items.question: What does onboarding look like for Enterprise?
items.answer: We start with a short discovery call, share a custom ROI estimate for your catalog size, and scope an onboarding timeline. No procurement deck is required to begin the conversation.

items.question: Is SOC 2 available today?
items.answer: SOC 2 Type II is in progress. Enterprise accounts can request our DPA, discuss data residency options, and review our security posture during the sales process.

items.question: Can Enterprise connect to our existing data stack?
items.answer: Yes. Enterprise includes read-only API access for scan results, agent traffic, and UCP profiles so you can integrate ecentic data into your own analytics and reporting tools.
